title: NOC wheel-ownership + modal-block policy (effect_zoom) has zero automated coverage — acceptance item, hard-bar (c)
detail: Briefing scope 3 + acceptance "NOC wheel-ownership respected" + lens-guard hard bar (c). Only evidence is manual PP_CAM_E2E captures; no test pins noc_panel_hit, the scroll-vs-zoom branch, the modal block, or release-build always-zooms.
recommended_fix: Unit-pin noc_panel_hit (inside/boundary/outside) and effect_zoom/effect_pan branches via a fixture App (the pullback_test precedent): wheel over panel scrolls-not-zooms (PP_DEBUG build), modal blocks zoom+pan, elsewhere zooms.

title: Pullback-yield paths untested: wheel/pan/selection/fit/toggle clears of an in-flight pullback have no test
evidence:
grep -n "app.pullback = false" app/main.odin:
1028:			app.pullback = false // an in-flight pullback ends with the toggle
1507:	app.pullback = false // v2-camera-zoom: an explicit home return ends any pullback
1522:			app.pullback = false
1593:		app.pullback = false
1716:	app.pullback = false // the wheel owns the camera — a pullback yields to the player
1737:	app.pullback = false // the pan owns the camera — a pullback yields to the player

(Line 1593's convergence clear IS tested; 1028/1507/1522/1716/1737 are referenced by no test — grep above found zero test refs.)
detail: PR body claims "Any user camera input (wheel, pan, selection, ESC) yields the pullback instantly". Five distinct clears implement it; none exercised by any test — a deleted clear would keep every gate green.
recommended_fix: Extend pullback_test: arm a pullback, then call effect_zoom/effect_pan/camera_set_selection/camera_set_fit and the SETTINGS_ROW_PULLBACK adjust; assert app.pullback == false after each.

title: Two-finger touch pan has no positive pin — parity asserts only the no-op contract; deleting touch_map's Pan emission keeps all gates green
detail: PR claims "two-finger touch pan now works". The exec Pan→on_pan seam is pinned via mouse only; the touch emission line above is exercised but never positively asserted — removing it fails nothing.
recommended_fix: Add one camera_input_test case: dispatch_frame with Two_Finger_Pan{dx,dy} device events (the parity gesture shape) and assert the on_pan hook receives the exact deltas through touch_map.

title: Pan-latch lifecycle edges untested: missed-release guard, begin_draw clear, start_run reset — new state transitions with no boundary tests
detail: Three new latch transitions (missed-release synthesis, draw-start clear, run-restart reset) have zero coverage; camera_input_test drives dispatch_frame directly, never the poll guard. A regression strands the latch → buttonless panning.
recommended_fix: Pin the mouse_map release-synthesis indirectly (latch armed + release event → closed, already partly covered) and factor the poll guard's condition into a testable predicate; assert begin_draw/start_run clear an armed latch.

title: PP_CAM_E2E drive is manual-only evidence — wired into no CI gate, harness verb, or documented helper (unlike NOC_E2E)
evidence:
grep -rn "CAM_E2E\|cam-e2e\|NOC_E2E\|noc-e2e" over --include="*.sh" --include="*.yml" ... matches only tools/run-dev.sh:
37:  echo "run-dev: e2e drive — real windowed run, scripted D presses, ON/OFF captures (bin/noc-e2e-*.png)"
38:  PP_NOC_E2E=1 ./bin/app-dev
39:  echo "run-dev: e2e done — bin/noc-e2e-on.png (panel) vs bin/noc-e2e-off.png (no panel)"

No CAM_E2E reference exists in .github/workflows/ci.yml or tools/ci-local.sh (both read in full).
detail: The PR's committed zoom captures are one-shot manual artifacts; nothing regenerates or diff-checks them, so they can silently go stale. (NOC_E2E is equally ungated — a consistent, pre-existing pattern.)
recommended_fix: Add a run-dev.sh subcommand documenting PP_CAM_E2E=1, and optionally a manual/nightly step that regenerates bin/cam-e2e-*.png and pixel-diffs them against docs/captures/v2-camera-zoom/.

title: Test-count claims misaligned: PR body says 4 camera-math tests (actual 6); claimed 14 new vs 16 actual; briefing says 18 pins
evidence:
_pr_body_camera_zoom.md:83: "- New pins: 4 camera-math tests (app/render/camera_test.odin) + 4 input"

grep -c '^@(test)' at bd3b142: app/render/camera_test.odin → 6; app/input/camera_input_test.odin → 4; app/pullback_test.odin → 4; app/settings_test.odin → 2 new (23 total). New tests = 16; PR body sums 4+4+4+2 = 14; briefing claims "18 pins total = 8 original + 10 new".
detail: Undercount, not overcount — actual coverage exceeds the claim — but three inconsistent counts (14/16/18) for the same change-set mislead future audits of the acceptance evidence.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body to "6 camera-math tests" and 16 new tests total, or reconcile the 'pins' terminology (tests vs assertions) in the briefing.
